permira::Zendesk.notes: Zendesk was acquired by an investor group led by Permira and Hellman & Friedman in November 2022 for approximately $10.2 billion. It is currently a private portfolio company of Permira.

permira::Mimecast.notes: Mimecast is a cybersecurity firm that was acquired by Permira in May 2022 for approximately $5.8 billion, taking the company private. It remains a current portfolio company of Permira as of early 2026.

permira::Neuraxpharm.notes: Neuraxpharm is a pharmaceutical company specializing in central nervous system (CNS) disorders, headquartered in Barcelona, Spain. It was acquired by Permira from Apax Partners in 2020. As of early 2026, Permira has initiated a sale process for the company, but it remains a current portfolio holding until the transaction is finalized.

permira::Adevinta.notes: Adevinta is a global online classifieds company headquartered in Oslo, Norway. It was taken private in 2024 by a consortium led by Permira and Blackstone and remains a current portfolio company as of early 2025.

permira::McAfee.notes: McAfee was taken private in March 2022 for $14 billion by an investor group led by Advent International and Permira. It remains a current portfolio company of Permira as of February 2026, with Permira Senior Advisor Bruce Chizen serving as Chairman of the Board.

permira::Dr. Martens.notes: Dr. Martens was acquired by Permira in 2014. While the company went public (IPO) on the London Stock Exchange in January 2021—an event often categorized as an 'exit' in private equity—Permira remains the largest shareholder, holding approximately 38% of the shares as of early 2026. Therefore, it is still an active portfolio company.

permira::TeamViewer.notes: TeamViewer is a real technology company headquartered in Göppingen, Germany. Permira acquired it in 2014, took it public in 2019, and completed its final exit by selling its remaining shares in September 2025.

permira::Allegro.notes: Allegro is a major Polish e-commerce platform headquartered in Poznan. Permira, alongside Cinven and Mid Europa Partners, acquired the company in 2016. While Allegro went public (IPO) on the Warsaw Stock Exchange in October 2020 and Permira has since reduced its stake through several block trades (most recently in December 2025), Permira still holds approximately 12.44% of the shares as of February 2026. Therefore, the investment is currently a 'partial exit' rather than a full exit.
